user.title: Vehicle
user.description: Pick the entities of your electric vehicle (or smart charger). The car needs a battery level, a charge limit you can set and a charging status; everything else is optional.

data_description.battery_level_entity: Sensor with the state of charge in %.
data_description.charge_limit_entity: Number entity the coach will set (daily limit / calibration limit).
data_description.charging_status_entity: Sensor with the charging state, e.g. charging, complete, stopped, disconnected.

optional.name: Optional settings
optional.description: Everything here can be left empty. Open it only if you want the coach to know more about your car.

data.home_only: Calibrate only when the car is at home

data_description.cable_entity: Binary sensor that is on while the cable is plugged in. Without it the cable state is derived from the charging status.
data_description.charging_power_entity: Sensor with the power the car draws (e.g. a connected wall box). When set, top balancing ends when this power stays near zero instead of when the status says 'complete'. Leave empty if your wall box is not connected to Home Assistant.
data_description.home_only: Off (default): the calibration also happens when you charge away from home. On: only at home — pick the location below.
data_description.location_entity: Device tracker or person used for 'only at home'.
data_description.home_zone: Only if you charge at home in a zone other than Home.

parameters.title: Charging & calibration
parameters.description: Tune the daily limit and how the periodic full charge works. You can change all of this later from the integration's Configure button.

data.abort_after_hours: Give up after unplugged / away for
data.restore_after_manual: Also restore the limit after a full charge I started myself

data_description.calibration_interval_days: A calibration becomes due at midnight of the Nth day after the previous one.
data_description.min_hold_minutes: Some cars report "complete" the moment they hit 100%. The limit is never lowered before this time has passed (unless the cable is unplugged).
data_description.top_balancing_timeout_minutes: Safety net: after this time the daily limit is restored whatever the car reports.
data_description.top_balancing_buffer_seconds: Extra wait after the end of balancing is detected.
data_description.finished_statuses: Values of the charging status sensor that mean the car stopped charging. Ignored while a charging power sensor is set.
data_description.abort_after_hours: If the car is unplugged or away while calibrating, restore the daily limit after this many hours. 0 = never.
data_description.notify_service: Leave empty to use persistent notifications.
data_description.idle_power_watts: At or below this power (W) the car counts as no longer drawing current. Used only if a charging power sensor is set.
data_description.idle_minutes: The power must stay at or below that level this many minutes. Used only if a charging power sensor is set.

reconfigure.title: Change vehicle entities
reconfigure.description: Use this when the entities of the car changed (for example after switching to another integration). Calibration history is kept.

set_limit_failed.title: Cannot change the charge limit of {vehicle}
set_limit_failed.description: Setting {entity} failed several times in a row, so the calibration cannot proceed. Check that the vehicle is reachable (awake, online, API quota available). The coach keeps retrying and this issue clears itself once a command succeeds.

entity_missing.title: Entity of {vehicle} not found
entity_missing.description: The entity {entity} configured for {vehicle} does not exist any more, so the coach is not acting on it. Use Reconfigure on the integration to select the right entity.

start_calibration.name: Start calibration
start_calibration.description: Calibrate at the next charge, regardless of how long ago the last full charge was.

cancel_calibration.name: Cancel calibration
cancel_calibration.description: Stop a running calibration, restore the daily limit and do not ask for a full charge again for 24 hours.

mark_calibrated.name: Mark as calibrated
mark_calibrated.description: Record a full charge, for example one done without the coach. Ends a running calibration.

timestamp.name: Date and time
timestamp.description: When the full charge happened. Defaults to now.

daily_limit_greater_than_calibration.message: The daily limit must be lower than the calibration limit.
